title: Visit to a Cemetery (November 1–8)
scope: Applicable only to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Devoutly visit a cemetery and pray, if only mentally, for the deceased.
description: A plenary indulgence, applicable only to the souls in purgatory, is granted to the faithful who devoutly visit a cemetery and pray for the departed during November 1 through 8.

title: Recitation of the Marian Rosary
scope: For self or applicable to the Souls in Purgatory
general_conditions: Prayer for the intentions of the Supreme Pontiff
Complete detachment from all sin, even venial
work_required: Recite five decades of the Rosary in a church, public oratory, or in a family, religious community, or pious association.
description: A plenary indulgence is granted if the Rosary is recited in a church or public oratory, or in a family, religious community, or association of the faithful.
